label: preparing
what: A discreet gathering in the great hall tomorrow at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves on its four tables. The watchman overheard builder ordering baker to coordinate supply, delivery and payment with innkeeper and freight, explicitly withholding discussion from the mayor. The lighting review may provide a pretext; a forty-year service celebration is only speculation. Secretary and watchman know of the report but are not established as knowing helpers.
